desc: A majestic wolf-shaped rift spirit: body of deep void black with lavender cracks, round black void face with two small glowing white eyes, crown of pale gold crystal shards, violet cloak, gold leg rings, grandest design. Cute simple pixel art pet, chunky pixels, small chibi body, right-facing 3/4 view, full body centered, single dark outline, flat 2-3 tone shading, limited palette of lavender, pale white, deep violet and warm gold, no halo, no sparkles, no background, no ground shadow.
